info.name: E-Commerce - Admin Service (Dashboard)
info.description: Run with the Collection Runner (the 'Wait ...' requests retry while Kafka events travel). Needs discovery-server, config-server and all services. Reads the dashboard first and remembers its numbers; then a customer pays for 2 lamps (sales, best sellers, low stock, activity), a second order's card is declined and it is cancelled unpaid, and the paid order is cancelled and refunded - each change is checked as a difference, so it works on a database with earlier orders too.

item.name: 0. Setup (customer, a lamp with 6 in stock)
Wait for the lamp's inventory item (Kafka)

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.code === 200; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('inventory-service created the lamp item', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);
// product-service knows the stock (the cart checks it there)
// Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.availableQuantity === 6; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('product-service knows the stock (the cart checks it there)', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);
pm.test('Last 30 days', () => pm.expect((new Date(s.to) - new Date(s.from)) / 86400000).to.eql(29));
// Remember the numbers: the checks below look at what changes

item.name: 2. A paid order: sales, best sellers, low stock, activity
Customer adds 2 lamps to the cart

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.code === 200; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('payment-service created the payment', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);

item.name: Wait: the sale is in the summary (Kafka)

exec: // one more paid order, gross sales up by its total
// Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.

const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.sales.paidOrders === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('basePaid')) + 1 && Math.abs((pm.response.json().data.sales.grossSales) - (Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('baseGross')) + Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderTotal')))) < 0.005; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('one more paid order, gross sales up by its total', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);

pm.test('Average order value = gross / paid orders', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.sales.averageOrderValue).to.be.closeTo(pm.response.json().data.sales.grossSales / pm.response.json().data.sales.paidOrders, 0.006));
pm.test('2 sold for INR 3,000 in 1 order', () => { pm.expect(lamp.unitsSold).to.eql(2); pm.expect(lamp.revenue).to.eql(3000); pm.expect(lamp.orders).to.eql(1); });
pm.test('Paid orders wait to be shipped, with the oldest time', () => { pm.expect(confirmed.orders).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(confirmed.oldestSince).to.be.a('string'); });

item.name: Wait: the lamp is low on stock - 4 left (Kafka)

exec: // 6 lamps - 2 reserved = 4, at or below the threshold of 5
// Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.some(i => i.productId === pm.collectionVariables.get('lampId') && i.available === 4); } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('6 lamps - 2 reserved = 4, at or below the threshold of 5', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);

item.name: Wait: activity feed shows the payment and the low stock

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.

const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.content.some(a => a.kind === 'ORDER_PAID' && a.orderNumber === pm.collectionVariables.get('orderNumber')) && pm.response.json().data.content.some(a => a.kind === 'LOW_STOCK' && a.productId === pm.collectionVariables.get('lampId')); } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('ORDER_PAID and LOW_STOCK lines', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);
pm.test('Readable line', () => pm.expect(line.message).to.match(/^Order ORD-\w+ paid: INR [\d,]+\.\d\d$/));
pm.test('Newest first', () => { const t = pm.response.json().data.content.map(a => a.occurredAt); pm.expect(t).to.eql([...t].sort().reverse()); });

item.name: Pay with a card that is declined (402)
Wait: the failed payment is in the summary (Kafka)

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.payments.failed === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('baseFailed')) + 1; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('one more failed payment', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);
pm.test('Says why', () => pm.expect(line.message).to.match(/failed: Your card was declined\.$/));
// one more order cancelled before payment
// Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.orders.cancelledBeforePayment === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('baseCancelledUnpaid')) + 1; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('one more order cancelled before payment', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);

item.name: 4. The paid order cancelled and refunded
Wait: the refund is in the summary (Kafka)

exec: // one more paid order cancelled, refunds up by its total
// Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.

const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.orders.cancelledAfterPayment === Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('baseCancelledPaid')) + 1 && Math.abs((pm.response.json().data.sales.refunds) - (Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('baseRefunds')) + Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderTotal')))) < 0.005; } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('one more paid order cancelled, refunds up by its total', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);

pm.test('Gross keeps the sale, net takes it back', () => { pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.sales.grossSales).to.be.closeTo(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('baseGross')) + Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderTotal')), 0.005); pm.expect(pm.response.json().data.sales.netSales).to.be.closeTo(pm.response.json().data.sales.grossSales - pm.response.json().data.sales.refunds, 0.005); });

item.name: Best sellers: a cancelled order isn't a sale

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.

const done = (() => { try { return pm.response.json().data.content.some(a => a.kind === 'PAID_ORDER_CANCELLED' && a.orderNumber === pm.collectionVariables.get('orderNumber')); } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('PAID_ORDER_CANCELLED line', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);
pm.test('With the reason and the amount to refund', () => pm.expect(line.message).to.match(/cancelled: Ordered by mistake.* \(INR [\d,]+\.\d\d to refund\)$/));

item.name: Wait: the lamps are back in stock - not low any more

exec: // Events travel through Kafka, so this can take a moment: retry this request until it's true.
const done = (() => { try { return !pm.response.json().data.some(i => i.productId === pm.collectionVariables.get('lampId')); } catch (e) { return false; } })();
pm.test('both cancellations released the lamps', () => pm.expect(done, 'still not true after 20 s - is Kafka running?').to.be.true);

item.name: 5. Sales per day, CSV, parameter checks

exec: pm.test("Today has this run's sale and refund", () => { pm.expect(today.paidOrders).to.be.at.least(1); pm.expect(today.refunds).to.be.at.least(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('orderTotal')) - 0.005); });
